mapper.select: select id, user_id, type, title, content, biz_id, is_read, read_time, create_time from notification where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc

select n.id, n.user_id, n.type, n.title, n.content, n.biz_id, n.is_read, n.read_time, n.create_time from notification n where n.user_id = #{hrId} and ( n.type not in (1, 2) or ( n.type = 1 and exists ( select 1 from delivery d inner join `user` u on u.id = d.user_id and u.status = 1 where d.id = n.biz_id ) ) or ( n.type = 2 and exists ( select 1 from interview i inner join delivery d on d.id = i.delivery_id inner join `user` u on u.id = d.user_id and u.status = 1 where i.id = n.biz_id ) ) ) order by n.create_time desc
